text:
ANTIFRAUD::fingerprint
Description
This command returns fingerprint data collected on the client side,
only in context of ANTIFRAUD_LOGIN event.
Syntax
ANTIFRAUD
::
fingerprint
Examples
when
ANTIFRAUD_LOGIN
{
log
local0.
"Client fingerprint: [ANTIFRAUD::fingerprint]."
}
Related Information
Valid Events:
ANTIFRAUD_LOGIN
